description: WRITES. Sets 'tell me when SYMBOL settles above/below LEVEL' on the caller's account: checked on settled closes, fires once, by push. Confirm symbol, side and level first. get_event_matrix setups carry a ready trigger.

condition.description: Fire when a settled close is strictly above (or below) the level.

level.description: The price level, in the instrument's own quote currency/units, > 0.

note.description: Optional plain-text note shown with the alert (max 140 characters, refused over it). No secrets or personal data.

origin.description: Optional short tag for where it was set, e.g. 'eventMatrix:metals'.

renew.description: Instead of setting a new alert: the id of an ACTIVE alert whose 90-day expiry to push out from now. The other arguments are ignored.

symbol.description: Exchange ticker, with a venue suffix for a non-US listing, e.g. 'GDX', 'SAP.DE'; FX as the 6-letter pair ('EURUSD'), indices by short code ('SPX'); futures whose code is also a US listing by their root behind a slash (/CL, /HG), coins by their USD pair (BTCUSD).

name: set_my_alert
